regions.merged_text: I wrote Mrs. Baker and Mary of your difficulties but that you were keeping up. So do keep up as long as the dear Good God wills. But of course avoid anxiety - what glory that will be for each of us in eternity, just, in the end to have been able to say "Thou knowest O Jesus! Thy will be done."
